scope: renderer presentation only; authoritative engine and full-run acceptance belong to integration

reflection.observedBefore: All realms reused masonry and mostly changed palette.
reflection.concreteImprovement: Six separate floor constructions, wall constructions and wall-clipped skyline landmarks.
reflection.secondPass: Water and tower-heart walks were too close in value to walls. Brightened traversable floor, darkened noninteractive wall detail; reduced furnace-window frequency to roughly one third.

reflection.observedBefore: Wukong only faced forward; attack mainly overlaid a slash.
reflection.concreteImprovement: Four facing sprites, foot contact walk cycle, direction-aware staff, four key combat poses and local hurt acknowledgement.
reflection.secondPass: Character gallery showed strike and impact sharing a pose. Added impact crouch, follow-through staff angle and arm change; framed icons at integer 2x scale to avoid crown cropping.

reflection.observedBefore: Most actions emitted the same particle shower.
reflection.concreteImprovement: Staff extends and lands; cicada flies to latch and returns without moving simulation; hair becomes stationed ghost; ghost returns on recall; doors split as wood; pickups travel toward HUD edge; fire-eye rays identify the illusion.
reflection.secondPass: Bridges, opened bars and clones originally appeared completed before their effect arrived. Presentation now temporarily masks final bridge/bar/clone visual until the corresponding landing stage, without modifying authoritative state.

reflection.observedBefore: Relic collection only had transient particles.
reflection.concreteImprovement: Restored floor seams and sprouts persist from relic state; two-tower roof line reads actual two-axis controls; furnace frieze windows read three real pairs of controls; final floor repeats the sixteen-bead empty-centre motif; six named NPC archetypes have unique silhouettes.
reflection.secondPass: Mapped control names back to entity IDs and added archetype field support, so restoration matches saved gameplay flags.

reflection.observedBefore: Reduced-motion preference left particles, slashes and floating-number motion active.
reflection.concreteImprovement: Standard/simple/reduced modes, system-reduction override, no shake by default, reduced-motion static acknowledgement, skipEffects that only clears presentation.
reflection.secondPass: The first check caught legacy item/relic bobbing. All legacy animation reads now use effective reduced state; renderer canvases at two later times are byte-identical in reduced mode.

limits: Isolated Chrome renderer harness and representative pixel review; these are not a claim of full gameplay, audio or mobile interaction acceptance. Integration checks must run the real game.
